arguments.content:
#!/bin/sh
# Nightly log backup. Bundles logs/ into a dated tarball and copies it to the
# destination. Destination is the BACKUP_DEST env var if set, else $DEST.
set -eu

# Backup destination: a local path, or "host:path" for a remote copy over ssh.
DEST="${BACKUP_DEST:-}"
if [ -z "$DEST" ]; then
    echo "backup.sh: backup destination not set (set BACKUP_DEST or fill in DEST below)" >&2
    exit 1
fi

STAMP=$(date +%Y%m%d)
BUNDLE="logs-$STAMP.tar.gz"

if [ ! -d logs ]; then
    echo "backup.sh: logs/ not found, nothing to back up" >&2
    exit 1
fi

tar -czf "$BUNDLE" logs/

case "$DEST" in
    *:*)
        # Remote: copy to user@host:path over ssh
        scp "$BUNDLE" "$DEST"
        ;;
    *)
        # Local: copy into the destination directory
        mkdir -p "$DEST"
        cp "$BUNDLE" "$DEST/"
        ;;
esac

echo "wrote $BUNDLE and copied it to $DEST"

arguments.command: chmod +x backup.sh && sh -n backup.sh && BACKUP_DEST=./tmp-backup ./backup.sh && ls -la tmp-backup && tar -tzf logs-*.tar.gz && rm -rf tmp-backup logs-*.tar.gz
